I have gone back and forth over which words to use after seeing the news about Christian Cooper and George Floyd. I woke up yesterday to see my name, Karen, trending on twitter again and when I clicked to see what was going on I saw video after video of racism from Amy Cooper.

My heart is heavy. M entire body is hurting. I feel that to speak on anything other than what is going on with the recent acts of racist violence is to stop contributing in this fight for our lives. I know that to let this world, to let whiteness, take my joy is to be defeated.
